sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Vijay Bahadur Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 1117 of 2022, under Sections 363, 376, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Kwarsi, District Aligarh, with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.
It has been argued by the learned counsel for the applicant/accused that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.

In her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., victim girl has stated that she herself has gone from Aligarh to Ghaziabad and there applicant came to receive her at railway station and thereafter, she has gone with the applicant to his room.
The allegation that the applicant has committed rape upon her, is thoroughly false.
It was submitted that the version of victim girl that she was subjected to rape by the applicant, is not supported by medical evidence.

The Prashant Alias Jatin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193742101/
1 victim has stated her age as 16 years.

entities.text: Prashant Alias Jatin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Referring to the facts of the matter, it was submitted that the version of victim girl is not reliable and that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case.

Lastly, it is submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 12.11.2022 and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and cooperate in the trial.

Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and argued that victim is a student of class 10th and as per school record, her age is less than 16 years and that in her statement under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., she has made allegations of rape against the applicant.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, gravity of offence and all attending facts and circumstances of case, the applicant is not entitled to be enlarged on bail.
Hence, the bail application of applicant Prashant Alias Jatin is hereby rejected.

Order Date :- 22.3.2023 Suraj  Prashant Alias Jatin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193742101/
